description: Source code for managing client certificate store using NSS in Chromium, including classes and functions for filtering and retrieving client certificates.

classes.name: ClientCertIdentityNSS
classes.description: Represents a client certificate identity using NSS, capable of acquiring private keys asynchronously.

methods.name: ClientCertIdentityNSS::AcquirePrivateKey
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the private key associated with the certificate.

methods.name: ClientCertStoreNSS::GetAndFilterCertsOnWorkerThread
methods.description: Retrieves and filters client certificates on a worker thread based on the request.

methods.name: ClientCertStoreNSS::GetPlatformCertsOnWorkerThread
methods.description: Fetches platform client certificates matching criteria.
